summary_1line: After crossing the ocean, Hanuman surveys the fortified splendor of Lanka, plans stealth, shrinks his form, and enters the city at night to search for Sita.

image_candidates.scene_text: Hanuman stands atop Trikuta Mountain overlooking the golden-walled city of Lanka shining with towers and banners beside the dark ocean.
As the sun sets, Hanuman shrinks his body to the size of a cat and leaps silently over the northern gate into the moonlit city.
From the mountain peak Hanuman gazes at the full moon rising over Lanka’s white palaces and golden archways while he prepares his secret mission.
